# UX Checklist: macOS Live Route Readiness

**Purpose**: Validate user-facing readiness, route state, recovery, and accessibility requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all user-visible route states specified: publication-only, checking, ready, stale, degraded, and failed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are recovery-action requirements defined for microphone failure, speaker failure, stale route, browser target change, and private app I/O loss? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005/FR-013]
- [x] CHK003 Are active non-recording route requirements distinct from active recording requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is `not ready for calls yet` defined as the required state when only publication is proven? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, SC-002]
- [x] CHK005 Are failure messages required to identify the failing path and reason rather than using generic readiness copy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK006 Are blocked/not accepted browser target states distinguishable from failed user setup? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Accessibility And Localization

- [x] CHK007 Are non-color-only state requirements defined for ready, stale, degraded, and failed states? [Constitutional Requirements]
- [x] CHK008 Are localization-safe labels required for route state and recovery action copy? [Constitutional Requirements]
- [x] CHK009 Are keyboard-reachable controls required for readiness and recovery actions? [Constitutional Requirements]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Are user-triggered readiness flows specified without implying hidden recording or automatic capture? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK011 Are browser-call validation outcomes specified without requiring the user to manually interpret raw diagnostics? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010/FR-015]
- [x] CHK012 Are Bluetooth warning/degraded UX requirements defined separately from built-in/wired release readiness? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]

## Notes

- These items test requirement quality, not implementation behavior.
